messages:
incident-bot: [ALERT] Pager: elevated 5xx + timeouts on /v1/generate (gateway) — spike detected since 2026-03-14T22:13:04Z. error_rate=12% (1m). sample_corr_id=ci-7a2f3b. dashboard: https://dash.internal/redwood/alerts/1795554444

mira: ack. assigning oncall. can someone grab kvlogs + traces for corrid ci-7a2f3b? we need timeline + top customer impact.

john: on it — pulling traces now. preliminary: upstream 503s start at 2026-03-14T22:12:58Z. lots of gateway retries observed. will paste snippets.

sre_lead: quick hypothesis: model-worker pool hitting steady OOM/restarts => upstream 5xx -> gateway retries -> amplification. mitigation options: disable gateway retries for this route, scale workers, route to fallback variant.

carla: copying. I'm going to push a temporary no-retry policy and set route fallback weight to 30%.

infra-oncall: scaling model-worker deployment from 8 -> 18 now (kubectl applied). rolling update started. ETA ~ 30s.

john: trace snippet for ci-7a2f3b (sanitized):

```
[2026-03-14T22:12:59.123Z] gateway req=ci-7a2f3b -> upstream 10.4.2.11 POST /v1/generate 502 body=nx
[2026-03-14T22:12:59.456Z] gateway retry count=1 for ci-7a2f3b route=/v1/generate
[2026-03-14T22:12:59.789Z] upstream 10.4.2.11 OOM_kill pid=4231 killed
[2026-03-14T22:13:00.012Z] upstream 10.4.2.12 started handling req ci-7a2f3b -> returned 503 after 480ms
[2026-03-14T22:13:05.500Z] gateway observed 8 concurrent retries for same parent request
```

mira: thanks. that OOM_kill line is worrying. john, can you grep kube events for node alloc pressure around 22:12:50-22:13:10? also include pod restarts.

john: running now.

```
$ kubectl -n runtime get events --sort-by=.metadata.creationTimestamp | tail -n 20
2026-03-14T22:12:57Z Pod model-worker-7 crashLoopBackOff: OOMKilled
2026-03-14T22:12:58Z Pod model-worker-7 kubelet: container CPU throttled
2026-03-14T22:13:01Z HPA scale to 12 replicas triggered
2026-03-14T22:13:10Z Pod model-worker-9 Ready
```

carla: pushed gateway config change: retries=0 for /v1/generate and circuit-breaker | max_concurrent=100. config diff:

```
- retries: 3
+ retries: 0
+ circuit_breaker:
+   max_concurrent: 100
```

deploy-bot: gateway-config rollout succeeded (cfg-2026-03-14-22-13-22) :white_check_mark:

infra-oncall: model-workers scaled to 18, new pods reporting ready ~22:13:40Z.

product-support: customer-impact: identified three customers with spike in 5xxs (acct: acme-co, beta-inc, edu-labs). sending outbound note to CS for ACME and BETA (they pushed high traffic earlier today).

mira: timeline draft so far:
- 22:12:56Z: slight increase in incoming concurrency (customer traffic)
- 22:12:58Z: first model-worker OOM -> pod restart (pod:model-worker-7)
- 22:12:59Z: upstream returns 502/503 for several requests
- 22:13:00Z: gateway retries triggered (retries default=3) -> fanout of duplicate upstream requests
- 22:13:05-22:13:40Z: retry amplification + worker restarts cause capacity to drop further
- 22:13:22Z: gateway config changed (retries=0 + circuit-breaker)
- 22:13:30Z: HPA/autoscaler kicked, scale to 18
- 22:13:40Z: new workers ready -> error rate drops
- 22:14:30Z: service back to normal baseline

john: uploaded kvlog + trace bundle to s3: s3://redwood-incidents/1795554444/ci-7a2f3b-kvlogs.tar.gz (beta access). includes grpc traces, gateway logs, pod logs.

carla: temporary mitigations done. next step: revert bucket-level heavy requesters? can we throttle the three offending accounts?

product-support: already flagged acct acme-co and beta-inc for rate-limiting; CS outreach in flight.

mira: hypothesis list (in-thread):
1) Primary: model-worker memory leak or workload causing OOMs -> pod restarts -> reduced capacity -> gateway retries amplify traffic -> cascading failures.
2) Secondary: autoscaler thresholds too conservative (scale-up lag) -> not reacting fast enough to retry storm.
3) Tertiary: a recent model build increased memory pressure for some inputs (correlation with deployments at 2026-03-14T18:00Z is possible).

sre_lead: agree. actions (immediate):
- post-incident RCA owner: mira
- collect heap profiles from affected pods (if available) 
- add permanent gateway circuit-breaker + retry policy change for heavy routes
- evaluate HPA thresholds and kube evictions sensitivity
- patch rollout rollback check for model build at 18:00Z

john: quick commands we ran:
```
kubectl -n runtime scale deploy/model-worker --replicas=18
curl -H "x-corr-id: ci-7a2f3b" -v https://gw.internal/v1/generate
kubectl logs model-worker-7 -n runtime --since=5m > model-worker-7.log
```

infra-oncall: noted. will keep the scaled replica count temporarily while we validate memory.

carla: I'll open a follow-up playbook PR to make retries=0 + cb the default for /v1/generate and add a dashboard tile for concurrent retry count.

mira: good. can someone summarize customer impact and link to kvlog in the incident ticket? I'll start a draft RCA doc and assign follows.

product-support: summary ready for ticket: "elevated 5xxs for /v1/generate between 22:12:58Z-22:14:30Z, impacted 3 paying customers; mitigations applied (disable gateway retries, scale workers). CS notified."

sre_lead: closing notes: marking this as mitigated at 2026-03-14T22:14:30Z. assigning RCA doc to mira. follow-ups: heap/profile capture, HPA tuning, retry defaults audit, and model build memory check (owner: carla). :thumbsup:

mira: thanks everyone. I'll post the RCA link in this thread when ready and attach the timeline + log bundle.

incident-bot: Incident auto-closed for pager 1795554444 (mitigated).
